local_vs_backend_status.initial_state: All features initially read and wrote exclusively to browser localStorage (via appStore). Supabase client was unconfigured and unused.
local_vs_backend_status.implemented_state: Dual-mode architecture implemented with explicit Production Mode vs. Demo Mode toggle. Production mode connects directly to Supabase via supabaseService (PostgreSQL + Auth + Storage). Demo mode runs in an isolated, high-fidelity local environment without external dependencies.

authentication.demo_engine: appStore persona switcher and local user registration

user_profiles.production_engine: Supabase 'profiles' table with RLS (phone number privacy enforced)

class_management_and_tokens.production_engine: Supabase 'classes' table with unguessable tokens, pause/active flags, and RLS
class_management_and_tokens.demo_engine: appStore classes array with token regeneration

invitation_registration.production_engine: Supabase query on 'classes' by invite_code, enrollments insert with pending status
invitation_registration.demo_engine: appStore token lookup and pending enrollment insert

daily_progress_feed.production_engine: Supabase 'daily_posts' table with class isolation RLS
daily_progress_feed.demo_engine: appStore daily posts with class filter

attachments_and_storage.production_engine: Supabase Storage bucket 'progress-attachments' with private RLS and signed URLs
attachments_and_storage.demo_engine: Base64 / data-URI storage in localStorage (max 25MB check)

reactions.production_engine: Supabase 'post_reactions' table with unique (post_id, user_id) constraint

mentor_feedback.demo_engine: appStore feedback arrays and notification dispatcher

weekly_reports.production_engine: Supabase 'weekly_reports' table with draft/submitted status and class isolation

cross_device_persistence_verification.demo_mode: Isolated to single browser origin (localStorage). Cannot sync across separate browsers or mobile devices without backend.
cross_device_persistence_verification.production_mode: Persisted in central PostgreSQL database (Supabase). Fully accessible across multiple browsers, incognito windows, and mobile devices as soon as valid Supabase credentials are configured in .env.

security_and_isolation.row_level_security: Enforced on all 9 tables in supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql. Students cannot query or write posts, reports, or enrollments outside approved classes.
security_and_isolation.url_tampering_defense: Class IDs and URLs cannot bypass RLS. Queries filtered by class_id that the student is not approved in return 0 records in Supabase.
security_and_isolation.phone_number_privacy: Phone column masked to non-mentors via RLS.
security_and_isolation.no_silent_fallback: Strictly enforced in AppContext.tsx and supabaseService.ts. When in Production Mode, database errors or missing credentials trigger a clear, dismissible production error banner and halt execution without silently falling back to mock data.
